title: 第四章 不是作弊【票票收藏】
novel_title: 长夜君主方彻最后结局(方彻)
content_zh: 有人皱眉“前面这些名字，有几个都曾经听说过，乃是不世出的天才，但是这个方彻，是什么时候冒出来的？”有人在疑惑。花白胡子皱着眉头：“再说这成绩也太诡异了些，从三十九，直接到九十一，全是两分两分的跳，说明斩杀的全是五级妖兽；一连斩杀二十六头五级妖兽？且不说妖兽群什么的，但……什么修为能这么砍瓜切菜的杀五级妖兽？”“一个既然报考武院，却还没有进入武院的武生，顶天了也就是武师吧？能做到？”众人纷纷摇头，除非是武宗。“难道是作弊了？”“作弊不可能吧，如果作弊的话，就被上报了。但那边的人到现在还没上报。”丛林中。两个黑衣人站在远方高处，在枝叶的遮挡中，一脸无语的看着远处前方。那是一个峡谷。无数的血牙妖狼，正兴冲冲的向着峡谷中冲进去。甚至，有些距离很远的血牙妖狼，竟然开启天赋神通，御风而来，急不可待的冲进去。峡谷中，正有一束香，在一個悬崖下的崖壁燃起。要想进入峡谷再进入悬崖，有几块巨石阻挡，只留下一条七拐八拐的路。小路仅能容一头妖狼进来，还要小心翼翼的才能不撞到石头上。而那个奸猾的小子，就在最后一个岔口等着。他脚踩着悬崖边，手持着风钢长剑，在他脚下的悬崖下方，线香发出最吸引血牙妖狼的灵兽安魂香，被他引导入七拐八拐的路。一头妖狼兴冲冲的找过来，刚露头，就被一剑斩下。杀狼不见血，但生机魂魄，在同一时间里被斩断。然后一把小刀一挖，一颗内核与几滴鲜血，同时进入名牌。飞起一脚。妖狼尸体已经被踢下悬崖。接着又来一头，同样一剑，一挖，一滴，一踢。操作熟极而流，只看动作，若是行云流水一般，活像是一个做这个工作做了几十年的熟练工。一头五阶妖狼，又一头，再一头……方彻动作麻利，干净利落，很是勤劳。但看着的两个武院的教习却是越来越是无语，越来越是一口老槽闷在嘴里，吐不出来，咽不下去。“这算作弊吗？”其中一个目瞪口呆的传音。另一个也觉得自己是满嘴黄连：“这还真不算作弊。”“啊？”“因为，他自始至终都是在战斗，虽然战斗容易了一些，但是，却的确是在战斗搏杀。”另一个人感觉自己说这话的时候，有点嗓子疼。两人同时默然。方彻是在战斗么？是。但是与别的天骄相比，他这个‘战斗’实在是太……轻松了。与他相同修为的遇到这种血牙妖狼，都是累个半死还未必能解决一头，自己还要受点伤。但他这，一剑、一挖、一滴、一扔。就完事了。轻松地就好像是吃饭的时候用馒头蘸一下蒜泥一样。但，偏偏不能说他作弊！这真是……而同样在看着的范天条张大了嘴，下巴都几乎砸在了地上，喃喃自语：“我尼玛……真特娘有他祖宗的创意奶奶滴老子今天算是开了一次眼界……”钱三江看的两眼发亮：“卧槽卧槽卧槽人才啊……”……悬崖并不高，只有二三百米，但从上面看下去，却是云雾弥漫，看不到底。就在悬崖下的地面上，无数的枯骨，一堆一堆。不断落下的妖狼尸体，在跌落地面后，一动不动。但是妖狼尸体的下面，却悄然的开始渗出鲜血。鲜血接触地面就立即消失。随着鲜血不断流逝，妖狼尸体也在不断失去光泽，鲜血流完了，而妖狼骨肉中的能量，还在持续的渗出，渗入地面。最后连狼皮也变得松弛，没有半点力道，就好像腐烂了好几年的破布一样，表面还完整，但是一口气就能吹散。只有妖狼的狼毛，还在上面附着，毛色鲜亮。哪怕有人下到悬崖下，看到了这些尸体，也不会注意这些妖狼实际上已经烂透了，只是原样没变而已。整片山林，从无数的地方，都在发生着这一幕，凡是失去生命的尸体，都在发生同样的变化。所有的能量都在渗入地底，向着某一个方向输送。但是，无人注意。方彻杀完了妖狼，也在不断的看着周围，总感觉，有什么地方不对劲。但是，无论如何，都找不出来。哪里的原因呢？……在地下深有数百丈的地方，有一具残破的身体，静静地躺着。似乎已经死了不知道多少年，只是还没有腐烂。无数的方向渗透下来的丝丝血气，就不断地向着身体集中而来。如同涓涓细流，向着大海汇聚一般。
content_en: The gray beard frowned: "Besides, this result is too weird. From thirty-nine to ninety-one, it was a two-point jump, which means that all the monsters killed were level five monsters. Killed twenty-six level five monsters in a row? Not to mention the group of monsters."Yeah, but...who can kill level five monsters like this?""A martial arts student who has applied for the martial arts academy but has not yet entered the martial arts academy is a martial arts master, right?"Everyone shook their heads, unless they were martial arts masters."Is it cheating?" "It's impossible to cheat. If you cheat, it will be reported. But the people over there haven't reported it yet." In the jungle.Two men in black stood at a high place in the distance, covered by branches and leaves, looking ahead in the distance with speechless expressions.That's a canyon.Countless blood-fang demon wolves were rushing into the canyon with great excitement.Even some blood-fang demon wolves that were very far away actually activated their innate magical powers, came with the wind, and rushed in impatiently.In the canyon, a bunch of incense was burning on the cliff below a cliff.If you want to enter the canyon and then enter the cliff, there are several boulders blocking it, leaving only a winding road.The path could only accommodate a demonic wolf, and one had to be careful not to hit rocks.And that cunning boy is waiting at the last fork.He stepped on the edge of the cliff, holding a wind steel sword in his hand. Under the cliff at his feet, the incense stick emitted the spirit beast requiem that most attracted the blood-fang demon wolf, and he was guided into the twists and turns of the road.A demon wolf came over excitedly, and as soon as it showed its head, it was chopped off with a sword.There is no blood involved in killing the wolf, but the vital soul is cut off at the same time.Then he dug it out with a knife, and a core and a few drops of blood entered the famous brand at the same time.A flying kick.The corpse of the demon wolf has been kicked off the cliff.Then another one came, with the same sword, a dig, a drop, and a kick.The operation is very familiar and fluent, just look at the movements. If it is fluent, it looks like a skilled worker who has been doing this job for decades.A fifth-level demon wolf, another one, and another... Fang Che moved quickly, cleanly, and very diligently.But the two teachers from the martial arts academy who were watching became more and more speechless, and their mouths became more and more stuffy, unable to spit out or swallow."Is this considered cheating?" one of them said in stunned silence.Another person also felt that he was talking too much: "This is really not cheating." "Huh?" "Because he was fighting from beginning to end. Although the fighting was easier, he was still fighting." The other person felt that his throat hurt when he said this.The two of them were silent at the same time.Is Fang Che fighting?yes.But compared to other geniuses, his 'battle' was really... easy.Anyone with the same level of cultivation as him would encounter such a blood-fang demon wolf, and they would be exhausted and half-dead, but they might not be able to kill one, and they would be injured a little.But what he did was a sword, a dig, a drop, and a throw.That's it.It's as easy as dipping a steamed bun into minced garlic while eating.But, you can't say he cheated!This is really... Fan Tiantiao, who was also watching, opened his mouth wide, and almost hit the ground with his chin, muttering to himself: "Oh my God... Zhente Niang has the creativity of his ancestors. Grandma Di, I opened my eyes today..." Qian Sanjiang's eyes lit up: "Fuck, fuck, fuck, what a talent..."... The cliff is not high, only two or three hundred meters, but when viewed from above, it is filled with clouds and mist, and you can't see the bottom.On the ground under the cliff, there are piles of countless dead bones.The corpses of the demon wolves that kept falling remained motionless after falling to the ground.But underneath the body of the demon wolf, blood quietly began to seep out.The blood disappears immediately when it touches the ground.As the blood continues to flow away, the body of the demon wolf continues to lose its luster. The blood has finished flowing, but the energy in the bones and flesh of the demon wolf continues to seep out and seep into the ground.In the end, even the wolf skin became loose and without any strength, just like a rag that had rotted for several years. The surface was still intact, but it could be blown away in one breath.Only the wolf fur of the demon wolf was still attached to it, and the fur was bright in color.Even if someone goes down to the cliff and sees these corpses, they will not notice that these demon wolves are actually rotten to the core, they just remain the same.This scene is happening in countless places throughout the mountains and forests, and all the dead bodies are undergoing the same changes.All energy is seeping into the ground and being transported in a certain direction.But no one noticed.After Fang Che finished killing the demon wolf, he kept looking around, feeling that something was wrong.However, no matter what, I couldn't find it.What's the reason?… Hundreds of feet deep underground, there was a broken body lying quietly.It seems to have been dead for who knows how many years, but it has not decayed yet.The traces of blood that penetrated from countless directions continued to converge towards the body.Like a trickle of water, gathering towards the sea.
